messages:
sam: Quick sync — Sycamore POC cutover scheduled Thu 4/8. Need owners + blockers. Who's owning infra/network, data sample, and QA gating? cc @maria @kevin

maria: I can own infra (VPC peering + route tables). Working on peering ticket NET-423. ETA tomorrow EOD.

kevin: I'll own app-side integration and schema mapping. Need test payloads from Sycamore. Can someone confirm they sent the sample?

noah: Sycamore sent sample v1 on Monday. Uploaded to S3 path s3://redwood-pocs/sycamore/samples/v1.json. @kevin can you access? I added a bucket policy for redwood-poc-role.

kevin: I can access, thanks. Quick Q: does POC need embeddings? If yes we should enable Dedicated capacity for peak tests.

rachel: Sales asked to validate latency SLA: 95th <= 120ms for 512-token calls. That's in the playbook. We should run load test on staging.

sam: Owners summary so far: infra=maria, app=kevin, data=noah, QA=rachel. Can QA run canary on Wed morning? Also any CRs blocking?

maria: VPC peering still needs a route table update on their side — partner network ops said they'd apply by Tue afternoon. Blocker: their firewall may block outbound to 172.16.0.0/16. Asking legal for IP whitelist.

kevin: :thumbsup: I'm blocked by an auth config difference — Sycamore uses basic token vs our JWT. I opened SE-189 for mapping adapters. Will push patch tomorrow.

sam: If SE-189 won't land, fallback plan is to use internal adapter via proxy. @angelina would that be OK from a security perspective?

angelina: Proxy approach OK for POC only, must document scope & TTLs. I'll add a note in the compliance doc.

rachel: QA plan: quick load profile: 50 rps for 15m with ramp. I'll schedule run Wed 9am PST. Need model pinned to r-3.1-provisioned. Who sets that?

noah: I can pin model on staging. Will set to r-3.1-provisioned by Tue EOD.

sam: Great. Can everyone add final acceptance criteria here? Sales wants 'NLP extraction accuracy >= .82 for core fields + latency SLA'

maria: Infra AC: VPC peering established, routes in place, no firewall drops.

kevin: App AC: mapping adapter in SE-189 merged OR proxy deployed, end-to-end fields match sample schema.

rachel: QA AC: extraction accuracy >= .82 on golden set, no 5xxs during canary, 95th latency <= 120ms.

sam: OK, blockers recap: partner firewall whitelist (partner ops), SE-189 merge (app), model pin (noah), canary schedule. Owners confirmed. I'll send calendar invite for Thu cutover window 10am-12pm PST. :calendar:

kevin: Heads-up: I'll need a quick CR review for the adapter — pinging eng-reviews channel shortly.

rachel: I'll post load test results after Wed run in this thread.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: canary staging -> prod window Thu 10:00 PST. Runbook: /runbooks/sycamore-poc.md

sam: Thanks everyone. If anything slips, mark here. :eyes:
